lagundi-001|leaves.title: Leaves
lagundi-001|leaves.description: Lagundi leaves are used for cough and asthma. DOH clinically validated. Traditional preparation: decoction.

sambong-001|leaves.title: Leaves
sambong-001|leaves.description: Sambong leaves are used for lowering uric acid and hypertension. Traditional preparation: decoction.

akapulko-001|leaves.title: Leaves
akapulko-001|leaves.description: Akapulko leaves are used for fungal infections (ringworm, athlete's foot). DOH approved. Applied as poultice or wash.

ampalaya-001|leaves.title: Leaves
ampalaya-001|leaves.description: Ampalaya leaves are used for asthma, coughs, and diabetes. Traditional preparation: decoction.

bawang-001|bulb.title: Bulb (Garlic)
bawang-001|bulb.description: Bawang bulb (garlic cloves) is used for wounds and toothaches. Applied topically as poultice. DOH approved.

bayabas-001|leaves.title: Leaves
bayabas-001|leaves.description: Bayabas leaves are used for wound healing, diarrhea, and stomach problems. Decoction or topical wash.

niyog-niyogan-001|seeds.title: Seeds
niyog-niyogan-001|seeds.description: Niyog-niyogan seeds are used for expelling parasitic worms. DOH approved. Use under proper dosage guidance.

tsaang-gubat-001|leaves.title: Leaves
tsaang-gubat-001|leaves.description: Tsaang gubat leaves are used for stomachaches and diarrhea. Traditional preparation: decoction.

ulasimang-bato-001|leaves.title: Leaves (Aerial parts)
ulasimang-bato-001|leaves.description: Ulasimang-bato aerial parts are used for gout, rheumatism, and headache. Eaten raw or as decoction.

tawa-tawa-001|whole plant.title: Whole plant
tawa-tawa-001|whole plant.description: Tawa-tawa (Euphorbia hirta) whole plant is traditionally used for dengue support and fever. Contains phytochemicals with platelet-enhancing properties. Use under medical guidance.

malunggay-001|leaves.title: Leaves
malunggay-001|leaves.description: Malunggay (Moringa) leaves are highly nutritious and used for malnutrition, inflammation, and blood sugar support. Rich in vitamins and minerals. Traditional preparation: fresh leaves in soup or tea.

oregano-001|leaves.title: Leaves
oregano-001|leaves.description: Oregano leaves are used for cough, respiratory and digestive issues. Contains antimicrobial compounds. Traditional preparation: decoction or tea.

luya-001|rhizome.title: Rhizome
luya-001|rhizome.description: Luya (ginger/turmeric) rhizome contains curcumin; proven anti-inflammatory. Traditional preparation: decoction, poultice, or grated in food. Do not substitute for medical treatment.

aloe-vera-001|leaf gel.title: Leaf gel
aloe-vera-001|leaf gel.description: Aloe vera inner leaf gel is used for burns and skin health. Avoid the yellow latex near the skin (strong laxative). External use well documented.

sampa-sampalukan-001|whole plant.title: Whole plant
sampa-sampalukan-001|whole plant.description: Sampa-sampalukan (Phyllanthus niruri) whole plant is used for kidney and liver support. Scientifically documented. Traditional preparation: decoction.

banaba-001|leaves.title: Leaves
banaba-001|leaves.description: Banaba leaves contain corosolic acid; proven anti-diabetic. Traditional preparation: decoction. Consult a doctor for kidney disorders.

kamoteng-kahoy-001|roots.title: Roots and leaves
kamoteng-kahoy-001|roots.description: Kamoteng kahoy (cassava) roots and leaves release cyanide if raw or improperly prepared. Never eat raw. Must be thoroughly cooked. Use with strict caution and professional guidance.

kamias-001|fruit.title: Fruit
kamias-001|fruit.description: Kamias fruit is high in oxalic acid. Excessive consumption may cause acute kidney injury. Use in moderation; avoid if you have kidney issues. Follow preparation and dosage guidance.

kakawate-001|leaves.title: Leaves
kakawate-001|leaves.description: Kakawate leaves are for external (topical) use only. Toxic if ingested. Used traditionally for skin wounds and scabies. Do not consume.

gumamela-001|leaves.title: Leaves and flowers
gumamela-001|leaves.description: Gumamela leaves and flowers are used for respiratory and skin conditions. Traditional preparation: decoction or poultice.

guyabano-001|leaves.title: Leaves
guyabano-001|leaves.description: Guyabano leaves are traditionally used for fever and pain. Preparation: decoction or tea.

mayana-001|leaves.title: Leaves
mayana-001|leaves.description: Mayana (Coleus) leaves are used for pain relief and inflammation. Traditional preparation: poultice or decoction.

calamansi-001|fruit.title: Fruit and juice
calamansi-001|fruit.description: Calamansi fruit and juice are rich in vitamin C; used for cough and immune support. Common in Filipino cuisine.

pomelo-001|fruit.title: Fruit and juice
pomelo-001|fruit.description: Pomelo fruit and juice are used for cough and digestive health. Rich in vitamin C.

siling-labuyo-001|fruit.title: Fruit
siling-labuyo-001|fruit.description: Siling labuyo fruit is used for pain relief and circulation. Use in moderation; can irritate digestive tract.

saluyot-001|leaves.title: Leaves
saluyot-001|leaves.description: Saluyot (jute) leaves are nutritious and used for digestive health. Common in Ilocano cuisine.

kamote-001|leaves.title: Leaves
kamote-001|leaves.description: Kamote (sweet potato) leaves are nutritious and used for digestive health. Common in Filipino cooking.

mango-001|leaves.title: Leaves
mango-001|leaves.description: Mango leaves are traditionally used for cough and respiratory support. Preparation: decoction.

sampalok-001|pulp.title: Pulp and leaves
sampalok-001|pulp.description: Sampalok (tamarind) pulp is used for digestive and laxative effects. Leaves in traditional preparations.

yerba-buena-001|leaves.title: Leaves
yerba-buena-001|leaves.description: Yerba buena leaves contain essential oils (menthol, carvone) responsible for the characteristic mint fragrance. Used as hot tea for headache, colds, and nausea; as a topical poultice for toothache; and as a warm compress for arthritis. DOH approved.
